main_text.p: טַלִּית Ch.Pallium, vestis longa exterior, à tegendo vel operiendo sic dicta, vel à טלל Portare, quòd super alias vestes portetur & induatur; היא טליית דמתכסי ביה Est pallium quo operit se, Hebr. כסותה, Exod.22.26. in Targ.Jon. Vide Eliam in Thisbi.
טלם Ch.& Syr.Opprimere, vi sc.vel fraude, Fraudare, defraudare, vim inferre, violenter detinere: Item Syr.Rejicere, spernere, aspernari.
טְלוֹמָא Ch.Oppressor: Item Nequam, Heb. בליעל, Proverb.6.12. Plur. טלומין, טלומיא.
טְלוֹמָא, טְלוּמָא, טְלוּמָא, טְלִימָא Ch. Oppresio, iniquitas, perversitas.
טוּלְמָא Ch. Torta panis, Frustum. Job.31.17. Esth.1.2. Plur. טולמין.
טלן טַלְנִי, טַלְנִין Ch.Lemures, larvæ, spectra nocturna. Cāt.38. Num.6.24. legitur טלוי in Jon. quod idē. טַלְנִיתָא, Vide supra in טלל.

טלע Ch.Educere, extrahere, detrahere: Item Claudicare. Hinc מַטְלַע Claudicans, vel claudus, Hebr. צולע, ט & ע permutatis, Genef.32.31. in Onk. Sic quoq; legend.in Jon. pro מַטְלַח. Ithpeh. אִתְטְלַע Extrahi, detrahi, Deut.29.4.in Jon.
טלף Pahel Ch. Findere, diffindere, discindere ungulas. Aphel אטלף Idem.
טְלַפָּא, טְלִפִין Ch.Ungulae, à Fissura sic dictae.
טלק Ch. Projicere, conjicere, dejicere, ejicere, injicere. Syr. ܛܠܩܐ Dejicitur &

page.notes: Right margin carries faint, illegible show-through from the reverse page and is omitted. Hebrew, Syriac and Greek-letter entries are transcribed as far as legible; several vocalised Aramaic forms are uncertain and may contain errors. Left-margin headword letters (טלם, טלן, טלע, טלף, טלק) are printed as large initials and are included in their entries.
